title: Mockup Design 1
description: A focused mockup set exploring surface, type, and visual rhythm.

details.overview: Mockups here are used to pressure-test hierarchy and brand presence before committing to production layouts.
details.challenge: Early visual exploration can drift into decoration before hierarchy and brand signals are proven.
details.solution: Tight mockup sets validate surface, type, and rhythm quickly so production work starts from clearer decisions.
